test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/720a44b73259bfe0478e5566170d74ba29115a4bd7e77466a90c089fe97f2eba.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

One line from the pentagon is removed and added to the middle of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c910df123d96f12ad237d166882a958c3164c999bd1f7dde65055f04e73d0f7f.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

One line from the rectangle is removed and added to the middle of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb13d307e512355e0e8913a3a72ea3f76c5c0b89739ae79d1e5a02e5e556932.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

One line from the triangle is removed and added to the middle of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe37b88744c22f3e8bcf33dbc7b09cbb010b9ebc5165ecc9fac901fb72fe60b.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

One line from the remaining shape is removed and added to the middle of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a998cf242ca34b3773d2f2c21d988e43d402cbdf1c9107a3888c1ef1c3d46ec.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (4)".**
